---
title: "STEPS: FETP scale-up decision aid"
description: "Plan the scale-up of Field Epidemiology Training Programmes in India under budget constraints."
---

Scaling a training programme means committing money years before the graduates
appear, and balancing three things that move against each other: cost,
stakeholder endorsement, and health benefit.

STEPS puts them in one place. It runs on a mixed-logit preference model estimated
from a discrete choice experiment with stakeholders, combined with cost templates
and epidemiological multipliers. Change the scale-up assumptions and it returns
endorsement estimates, perceived programme value, cost per cohort, a national
simulation, and scenario exports.

For policymakers and partners planning FETP scale-up in India.

[Open STEPS](/STEPS-FETP-DecisionAid-V20/){.open}

::: {.note}
Developed at the University of Newcastle in partnership with the World Bank. See
[the project](/research/projects/fetp-india/).
:::
